decision: Keep both Chibi hand styles as independently selectable variants; `small` is the normal fingered hand, not a synonym for mitten, and neither style replaces or overwrites the other.

small.label_zh: 正常手（小巧、有可辨手指）
small.role: preserve a natural small, fingered hand silhouette with readable digit separations; keep it distinct from the mitten style

mitten.role: add the rounded, simplified hand silhouette marked by the user as a second style
mitten.source_boundary: Use only as a shape/style guide. Do not crop production hand sprites from the annotated screenshot; derive clean parts from an approved Chibi source.

rig_contract.selection_rule: Exactly one left/right hand-style pair is visible at a time; both source variants remain in the candidate and can be switched without rebuilding or replacing the other.
rig_contract.cuff_rule: Both variants share the same Chibi wrist anchors and preserve the source cuff/ribbing; use a cuff-front overlap or sufficient wrist insertion so no bare cut edge, gap, or color discontinuity appears during rotation.

acceptance: The small/normal style must visibly read as a hand with distinct fingers; do not accept a vague or mitten-like silhouette as proof that the normal hand is complete.
Keep the rounded glove-like mitten style as a separate selectable option; neither style may erase or replace the other.
Confirm wrist root, cuff opening, sleeve bands, skin colors, and left/right proportions from the Chibi design source before cutting.
Keep each style as separate left/right parts with independent visibility bindings; no Teen sprites or Teen hand generator output may be substituted for Chibi art.
Switch small <-> mitten in both directions: no double hands, holes, positional jump, scale jump, stale opacity, or loss of either source variant.
Check cuff occlusion and continuity at default, wrist rotation extremes, wave, heart_hands, and surprised poses.
Run the matrix over short/long/twin-tail/hood combinations in the actual C engine, capture full-body and wrist close-ups, and visually inspect every capture.
Keep the style selector independent from gesture pose so either hand style can use supported actions without changing its anatomy.
